scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package jx-core alembic upgrade head
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @jx/web lint && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @jx/web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @jx/contracts typecheck && uv run pyright
scripts.test: corepack pnpm test:tooling && corepack pnpm --filter @jx/web test && uv run --package jx-core pytest -m "not integration" apps/core/tests && uv run --package jx-jobs pytest -m "not integration" apps/jobs/tests
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest scripts/qa/tests
scripts.test:db: TEST_DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:?TEST_DATABASE_URL is required} RUN_DATABASE_INTEGRATION=1 uv run --package jx-core pytest -m integration apps/core/tests && TEST_DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:?TEST_DATABASE_URL is required} RUN_DATABASE_INTEGRATION=1 uv run --package jx-jobs pytest -m integration apps/jobs/tests
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm contracts:check && corepack pnpm build
